dbab pa sngon du 'gro bas dkyil 'khor du gzhug pa dang*/ dkyil 'khor sgrub pa'i cho ga lhag ma bstan pa/ zhugs pa la dbang bskur ba/ spyod pa'i dam tshig dpog pa'o/ /dang po la gnyis/ ye shes dbab pa'i cho ga khyad par ba dang*/ dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa'i snying po'o/ /dang po ni/ rnam snang mdzad kyi sbyor ba yis/ /nas byin gyi brlabs ni rab tu gsol/ zhes so/ /gnyis pa ni/ /de la 'di ni dkyil 'khor chen por nas/ rdo rje'i snying po'i zhes so/ /gnyis pa dkyil 'khor sgrub pa'i cho ga lhag ma ni/ de la 'di ni rdo rje chen po/ nas/ sil snyan dri yi sprin rnams bsgom/ zhes so/ /gsum pa zhugs pa la dbang bskur ba la bzhi/ bum pa'i dang*/ gsang ba'i dang*/ shes rab ye shes kyi dang*/ bzhi pa'i dbang bskur ba'o/ /dang po la lnga/ dbang lha spyan drangs te chu dbang bskur ba/ slob ma la lus kyi dkyil 'khor dgod pa sngon du byas nas de'i 'og tu dbang bskur ba/ dbang bskur ba dang dbang gi don du gsol ba gdab pa/ dkyil 'khor bstan cing dam tshig bsgrag pa/ lha dang sngags kyi rjes gnang sbyin pa'o/ /dang po ni/ 'di skad kyang gsungs so/ /nas/ bzung bar mkhas pa dag gis bsgom/ /zhes so/ /gnyis pa ni/ rdo rje rnam par snang mdzad bsam/ nas/ dgod par bya/ zhes so/ /gsum pa ni/ de la 'di ni dbang bskur ba nas/ snying khar bdag po bzhag par bya/ zhes so/ /bzhi pa ni/ rdo rje slob ma blo ldan la/ nas/ dam tshig mchog tu brtag pa'o/ /zhes so/ /lnga pa ni/ sngags kyis bskul ba smras pa yis/ nas/ ting nge 'dzin dang*/ zhes so/ /gnyis pa gsang ba'i dbang ni/ gsang ba byin pa brtsam par bya/ nas/ dngos grub rnyed mi dka'/ zhes so/ /gsum pa shes rab ye shes kyi dbang ni/ rnam pa 'di bzhi gsang chen te/ nas/ don spyod phyir gnas pa'o/ /zhes so/ /bzhi pa dbang bzhi pa ni rgyud phyi ma dang rdo rje 'chang ba las mdor bstan te/ mtha' gcod dang dkyil chog sogs las shes par bya'o/

/bzhi pa spyod pa'i dam tshig ni/ de la 'di ni dkyil 'khor thams cad/ nas/ de skad ces bka' stsal to/ zhes so/ /gnyis pa dngos grub kyi cho ga la gnyis/ dbang bskur bas dam tshig bsrungs na dngos grub gnyis ka 'grub par bstan pa dang*/ dngos grub bsgrub pa'i las tshogs so sor bshad pa'o/ /dang po ni/ dngos grub thams cad sgrub pa dang*/ nas/ dkyil 'khor dag gis thams cad 'grub/ zhes so/ /gnyis pa la drug /sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga'i ril bu'i sgrub pa/ mngag gzhug sgrub pa/ rdo rje 'jam dpal gyi sgo nas rgyal po la sogs pa dbang du bya ba/ gdul bya ma dad pa dad par byed pa'i sbyor ba/ rnam snang gi sgo nas bkres skom zhi ba'i sbyor ba/ lha so so'i sgrub thabs la brten nas las sgrub pa'o/ /dang po ni/ bshang gci dang ni sha chen rnams/ nas/ lhan cig 'khod/ ces so/ /gnyis pa la bdun/ 'jig rten las 'das pa'i mngag gzhug bsgrub pa/ 'jig rten pa'i mngag gzhug pa bskul ba/ mngag gzhug pa sgrub pa'i gnas dang dus/ mngag gzhug pa sgrub pa'i phan yon no/ /mngag gzhug pa bskul ba'i snying po/ mngag gzhug bsgrub pa'i tshul bsdus te bstan pa/ mjug bsdu ba'o/ /dang po la gsum/ mngag gzhug pa'i sgrub ba thun mong du bstan pa/ rigs so sor byed ba'i sgrub pa/ mngag gzhug pa bskul tshul lo/ /dang po ni/ 'di skad ces kyang gsungs te/ nas/ āḥlaṃḥdhī/ zhes so/ /gnyis pa ni/ phyag na rdo rje'i gzugs chen dang*/ nas/ gsang ba'i gnas bzhag go /zhes so/ /gsum pa ni/ de la 'di ni rdo rje nas/ snying po thams cad bskul ba'o/ /āḥzhes so/ /gnyis pa 'jig rten pa'i mngag gzhug bskul ba ni/ mdung rtse che dang rdo rje che/ nas/ byang chub rab tu 'grub/ zhes so/ /gsum pa ni/ 'di skad ces kyang gsungs so/ /nas/ thob pa gdon mi za/ zhes so/ /bzhi pa phan yon la gnyis/ rig 'dzin gyi 'khor tshad med pa 'grub tshul dang*/

sangs rgyas kyi zhing du khrid nas mchog 'grub pa'i tshul lo/ /dang po ni/ ri rab sum cu rtsa drug gi /nas/ byang chub 'grub/ zhes so/ / gnyis pa ni/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ nas/ de skad ces bka' stsal to/ /zhes so/ /lnga pa snying po ni/ de la 'di ni mngag gzhug /nas/ rtag tu bskul/ zhes so/ /drug pa la gnyis/ dngos kyi don dang*/ mngag gzhug pas las sgrub tshul lo/ /dang po ni/ de la 'di ni rdo rje ye shes nas/ dam tshig bcing ba'o/ /zhes so/ /gnyis pa ni/ mkha' dbyings rgya chen dag pa ni/ nas/ rmad byung gzugs can no/ /zhes so/ /bdun pa mjug bsdu ba ni/ bcom ldan nas/ bka' stsal to/ /zhes so/ /gsum pa rdo rje 'jam dpal gyi sgo nas rgyal bo sogs dbang du bya ba ni/ sangs rgyas rdo rje sems dpa' 'ang rung*/ nas/ rdo rje'i blo yi don gyis gsungs/ zhes so/ /bzhi pa ma dad pa dad par byed pa ni/ sangs rgyas dkyil 'khor mchog dag ni/ nas/ sku gsum rdo rje can du mthong*/ zhes so/ /lnga pa bkres skom zhi ba ni/ bkres skom la sogs nyon mongs che/ nas/ de skad ces bka' stsal to/ /zhes so/ /drug pa las sgrub pa la lnga/ dpa' bo rdo rje'i sgo nas zhi sogs kyi las thams cad sgrub tshul/ skul byed pa'i sgo nas las sgrub tshul/ dzam+bha la'i sgo nas nor sgrub tshul/ gnod sbyin mo dbang du byas nas las sgrub tshul/ mkha' 'gro ma gnyis dang snyoms par zhugs pas 'bras bu gnyis 'grub tshul lo/ /dang po ni/ de nas bcom ldan 'das phyag na rdo rje nas/ ting nge 'dzin to/ /zhes so/ /gnyis pa ni/ de nas bcom ldan 'das kun nas dbyangs rdo rje nas/ ting nge 'dzin to/ /zhes so/ /gsum pa ni/ de nas bcom ldan 'das phyag na rdo rje nas/ ting nge 'dzin to/ /zhes so/ /bzhi pa ni/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das nas/ ting nge 'dzin to zhes so/ /lnga pa ni/ de nas bcom ldan 'das nas/ de skad ces bka' stsal to/

/zhes so/ /gsum pa spyod pa'i cho ga la drug /spros med bsdus pa'i spyod pa bya tshul/ shin tu spros med kyi spyod pa bya tshul/ spyod pa'i 'bras bu/ spros med kyi spyod pa'i thun mong ba'i cho ga /spyod pa gnyis la brten nas sgrub pa pos lam bgrod tshul spyod pa'i gzhung nye bar bsdu ba'o/ /dang po la lnga/ mtshams sbyor sngon 'gros spyod pa byed pa cha lugs bsgrub dgos par bstan pa/ rigs gsum so so phye ba'i spyod pa byed tshul/ kha zas la longs spyod tshul phan yon dang bcas pa/ nges don gyi dam tshig bzhi la gnas par bya ba/ rang rigs kyi phyag rgya ma ma rnyed na ji ltar bya ba'o/ /dang po ni/ de nas phyag na rdo rje nas/ de ltar dngos grub thob par 'gyur/ /zhes so/ /gnyis pa ni/ de la 'di ni sku dang gsung dang thugs nas/ gsang ba'i mchod pa rab tu bya zhes so/ /gsum pa ni/ sdong bu rtsa ba 'bras bu yi/ /nas/ gdon mi za bar 'thob par 'gyur zhes so/ /bzhi pa ni/ rtag tu gzhan gyi nor rku zhing*/ nas/ kun tu bsdoms/ ces so/ /lnga pa ni/ 'dod chags rdo rje lcags kyu mo/ /nas/ kun du rigs zhes so/ /gnyis pa shin tu spros med kyi spyod pa ni/ bsam bstan yig gsum rdo rje can/ nas/ de dag skrag nas ster bar 'gyur/ /zhes so/ /gsum pa spyod pa'i 'bras bu ni/ rdo rje bdag nyid gsum 'das nas/ /rdo rje'i yi ge 'jig par 'gyur zhes so/ /bzhi pa spyod pa'i thun mong gi cho ga ni/ lha mo klu mo gdon sbyin mo/ /nas/ ye shes bsten/ zhes so/ /lnga pa lam bgrod tshul ni/ 'di ni sngags rnams thams cad kyi/ nas/ sangs rgyas byang chub rab 'jug pa'o/ /zhes so/ /drug pa spyod pa'i gzhung nye bar bsdu ba ni/ bcom ldan 'das/ zhes pa nas/ de skad ces bka' stsal to'i bar ro/ /gnyis pa le'u'i mtshan ni/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad/ zhes pa nas/ le'u ste bcu drug pa'o/ /zhes pa'i bar ro/

/bcu bdun pa rdo rje'i byin rlabs kyi rgyal po'i le'us bshad tshul la gnyis/ le'u'i gzhung dang*/ le'u'i mtshan no/ /dang po la bzhi/ mtshams sbyor nas bstod cing gsol ba gdab pa/ bstod pa la ston pa dgyes nas gsung pa la mngon du phyaugs pa/ gsol ba btab pa'i don bshad pa/ mjug sdud pa'o/ /dang po ni/ de nas bcom ldan 'das/ zhes pa nas/ de yang sangs rgyas 'dra bar 'gyur/ zhes pa'i bar ro/ /gnyis pa ni/ de nas ston pa rdo rje 'dzin/ nas/ nam mkha'i dbyings bzhin dri ma med zhes so/ /gsum pa la dgu/ dam tshig dang sdom pa rnams bstan pa/ mtshan ma med pa'i ting nge 'dzin gtan la dbab pa/ de'i thabs su lha'i sku ji ltar bskyed ba spyod pa'i dam tshig dang bcas pa/ 'khor gyi dris lan gyis bla ma bsnyen bkur tshul bstan pa/ bsam gtan gyi dkyil 'khor la brten nas kyang dbang rdzogs par bskur tshul/ las tshogs mchod pa dam tshig rnams spel nas bstan pa/ rgyud kyi che ba bstan pa/ thos bsam gyis the tshom chod nas nyams su blangs pa'i 'bras bu bstan pa/ rgyud yongs su gtad pa'i tshul lo/ /dang po la gsum/ theg pa gsum gyi dam tshig dang sdom pa/ 'jig rten pa gzhan gyi dam tshig dang sdom pa/ rim pa gnyis la gnas pa'i so so'i dam tshig dang sdom pa bstan pa'o/ /dang po la gsum/ rigs gsum gyi bza' ba dang bsrung ba'i dam tshig bstan pa/ rang sangs rgyas kyi dam tshig bsten tshul/ nyan thos kyi dam tshig bsten tshul lo/ /dang po ni/ de nas phyag na rdo rje nas/ de ma thag tu sangs rgyas 'gyur/ /zhes so/ /gnyis pa ni/ de nas phyag na rdo rje nas/ dam tshig mchog tu rtag pa'o/ /zhes so/ /gsum pa ni/ de nas phyag na rdo rje nas/ dam tshig 'di ni rmad po che/ zhes so/ /gnyis pa 'jig rten pa gzhan gyi dam tshig dang sdom pa la bzhi/ gtso bo gsum gyi dam tshig 'khrul spong dang bcas pa/ rdzu 'phrul chung ba lnga'i dam tshig gi

/dam tshig de brgyad la la gsang ba 'dus pas kyang spyad par bya ba/ don bsdu ba khung dang bcas pa'o/ /dang po ni/ de nas phyag na rdo rje nas/ de nyid khyab 'jug rdzu 'phrul che/ /zhes so/ /gnyis pa ni/ de nas phyag na rdo rje nas/ gnas kyi mtshan nyid kyis gsad bya zhes so/ /gsum pa ni/ ngo bo nyid kyi kun 'byung ba nas/ ma lus spyad par bya/ zhes so/ /bzhi pa ni/ khams gsum pa nas/ ting nge 'dzin to/ /zhes so/ /gsum pa rim pa gnyis la gnas pa so so'i dam tshig la drug/ rdzogs rim pas las kyi lam rnams 'od gsal gyis dag par bya ba'i dam tshig dang sdom pa/ bskyed rim pa dang rdzogs rim pas phyag bya ba dang mi bya ba'i tshul/ bskyed rim pas 'dod yon la longs spyod pa'i dus su yul dbang rnams thabs shes su sdud pa'i sdom pa/ rdzogs rim pas tha mal ba'i lus spangs nas rdo rje'i sku bskyed pa'i thabs kyi dam tshig /nang la gzhol ba rnams kyi tshim par bya ba'i cho ga /sngags la gzhol ba rnams kyi tshim par bya ba'i cho ga'o/ /dang po ni/ de nas phyag na rdo rje nas/ de skad ces bka' stsal to/ /zhes so/ /gnyis pa ni/ de nas phyag na rdorje nas/ dam tshig rdo rje las byung ba'o/ /zhes so/ /gsum pa ni/ de nas phyag na rdo rje nas/ dam tshig rab tu brtag pa'o/ /zhes so/ /bzhi pa ni/ de nas phyag na rdo rje nas/ dam tshig rdo rje rdzogs byed pa'o/ /zhes so/ /lnga pa ni/ de nas phyag na rdo rje nas/ khros pa rnams kyis mi thub pa'o/ /zhes so/ /drug pa ni/ de nas phyag na rdo rje nas/ de skad ces bka' stsal to/ /zhes so/ /gnyis pa mtshan med kyi ting nge 'dzin la lnga/ rjes 'jug gi las tshogs la stong pa nyid kyi ting nge 'dzin dgos par bstan pa'i phyir du ston pa 'od gsal du zhugs pa/ de la sngon byung gi dgos pa bstan pa'i phyir du 'khor rnams kyis dris lan mdzad pa/ de la ston pa mnyes nas don de nyid rang gi gsung gis ston par mdzad pa/

slob bzhin pa'i rnal 'byor pas sangs rgyas su 'grub pa'i rgyu la zhus lan mdzad pa/ 'od zung gi ting nge 'dzin bshad pa la/ 'khor rnams kyis ngo mtshar du gyur pa'o/ /dang po ni/ de nas phyag na rdo rje nas/ cang mi gsung bar gyur to zhes so/ /gnyis pa la bzhi/ 'khor gyi byang sems rnams kyis 'od gsal la/ zhugs pa'i rgyu mtshan zhus pa/ de'i lan 'khor gyi de bzhin gshegs pas gsungs pa/ lan de la log par rtog pa 'jam dpal la sogs pas bsal ba/ 'khor gyi de bzhin gshegs pas byang chub thob par yod med kyi tshul du bstan pa'o/ /dang po ni/ de nas yang nas/ cang mi gsung bar bzhugs/ /zhes so/ /gnyis pa ni/ de nas bcom ldan 'das nas/ log par bzung bas zin pa yin zhes so/ /gsum pa la gnyis/ log par bzung ba zhes pa'i tshig don la log rtog bsal ba dang*/ 'od zung gi zab pa dang rgya che dgos pa bstan pa'o/ /dang po ni/ de nas 'jam dpal nas/ byon pa'i rjes su 'gro'o/ /zhes so/ /gnyis pa ni/ de c-i'i slad du zhe na nas/ sems pa yang mchis so/ /zhes so/ /bzhi pa la gnyis/ don dam par thob bya sogs/ ma grub pas byang chub rnyed dka' bar bstan pa dang*/ tha snyad du rnyed sla bar bstan pa'o/ /dang po ni/ de nas bcom ldan 'das nas/ mi 'gyur ba las byung ba'o/ /zhes so/ /gnyis pa ni/ rigs kyi bu nas/ rdo rje ye shes thob pa'o zhes so/ /gsum pa ston pa mnyes nas lan mdzad pa ni/ de nas phyag na rdo rje nas/ smra ba byed pa smra ma yin/ zhes so/ /bzhi pa sangs rgyas 'grub pa'i rgyu zhus pa la gsum/ 'khor gyi de bzhin gshegs pas sangs rgyas thams cad kyi dngos grub gang las 'byung ba dang gang du thim pa'i rgyu zhus pa/ ston pas rang gi lus ngag yid gsum 'od gsal du zhugs pa rgyu yin par bstan pa/ de la slar zhus lan mdzad pa'o/ /dang po ni/ de nas bcom ldan 'das nas/ gang na gnas zhes so/ /gnyis pa ni/ de bzhin gshegs pa nas/

rgyud kyi rdo rje la gnas so zhes so/ /gsum pa la gnyis/ dngos grub dang khams gsum thams cad kyi rtsa gang yin zhu ba dang*/ de'i rtsa ba 'od gsal dang de la rtsa ba gnyis pa med par bstan pa'o/ /dang po ni/ de bzhin gshegs pa nas/ gang na gnas/ zhes so/ /gnyis pa ni/ de bzhin gshegs pa nas/ gang na yang ma yin no zhes so/ /lnga pa 'od zung bshad pa la 'khor rnams ngo mtshar ba ni/ de nas byang chub sems dpa' nas/ de rgyu gzugs ni rnam par bsgom zhes so/ /gsum pa lha sku bskyed pa spyod pa dam tshig dang bcas pa la lnga/ rigs so so'i sngags kyi bskyed pa'i thabs/ rdzogs rim pa'i spyod pa/ des lag pa'i phyag rgya mi bcing pa'i dam tshig /phyag rgya ma la brten pa'i sku gsung thugs kyi dam tshig gsum bstan pa/ spyod pa gsum la gnas pas phyi rol gyi lhar zhen pa bsal nas bdag nyid lhag pa'i lhar blta ba'i dam tshig go /dang po ni/ de nas ston pa rdo rje 'dzin/ nas/ de skad ces bka' stsal to/ /zhes so/ /gnyis pa la gnyis/ ye shes kyi phyag rgya la brten pa'i spyod pa phan yon dang bcas pa dang*/ las kyi phyag rgya la brten pa'i spyod pa phan yon dang bcas pa'o/ /dang po ni/ khams gsum las byung rgyal bo che/ nas sku gsum dngos grub thob bar 'gyur/ /zhes so/ /gnyis pa ni/ de nas yang bcom ldan nas/ skad cig gis ni sangs rgyas 'thob zhes so/ / gsum pa rdzogs rim pas lag pa'i phyag rgya mi bcing ba ni/ de nas phyag na rdo rjes nas/ rgyal ba rnams kyang mi 'da'o/ /zhes so/ /bzhi pa phyag rgya ma la brten pa'i sku gsung thugs kyi dam tshig la gsum/ rig ma dang*/ snyoms par zhugs pas bskyed pa'i bdud rtsi zos pa'i bcud len gyis lus stobs rgyas par bya ba/ gsung rdo rje'i lces rtsa bskul nas bde ba bskyed pa de las byung ba'i bdud rtsi lces myang ba/ pad+ma can la sogs pa'i phyag rgya rnams kyis yid dga' bar bya zhing de rnams kyi thugs sun mi 'byung bar mjug sdud dang bcas pa'o/

/dang po ni/ de nas yang phyag na rdo rje nas/ gsang 'di rdo rje gsum byung yin/ zhes so/ /gnyis pa ni/ /de nas yang bcom ldan nas/ gsung gi rdo rje mi smad do/ /zhes so/ /gsum pa ni/ de nas yang phyag na rdo rjes nas/ de skad ces bka' stsal to/ zhes so/ /lnga pa bdag nyid lhar blta ba'i dam tshig ni/ de nas yang phyag na rdo rjes nas/ de skad ces bka' stsal to zhes so/ /bzhi pa bla ma bsnyen bkur tshul la gsum/ 'khor rnams la dris lan gyi skabs dbye ba'i phyir ston pa 'od gsal du zhugs pa/ de'i tshe 'khor rnams kyis dris lan ji ltar mdzad pa/ de nas byang chub sems dpa' rnams the tshom chod nas thugs rangs pa thob pa'o/ /dang po ni/ de nas bcom ldan/ nas/ mi gsung bar gyur to/ /zhes so/ /gnyis pa la bzhi/ byams pas 'dus pa'i slob dpon la ji ltar blta zhes 'khor gyi de bzhin gshegs pa rnams la zhus pa/ byams pa la de'i lan mdzad pa/ 'khor gyi de bzhin gshegs pa lngas byang chub sems dpa' rnams la bla ma'i bsngags pa bstan pa/ sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub gang la gnas pa'i dris lan no/ /dang po ni/ de nas yang byang chub nas/ ji ltar blta bar bgyi/ zhes so/ /gnyis pa ni/ rigs kyi bu nas/ cang mi smra bar gyur to/ / zhes so/ /gsum pa ni/ de nas de bzhin gshegs pa nas/ ye shes kyi bdag po yin pa'i phyir ro/ /zhes so/ /bzhi pa la gsum/ dngos grub kyi rtsa ba gang yin zhus pa/ /de bla ma yin par bstan pa'i lan/ /bla ma'i rdo rje gsum yang rdo rje 'chang la gnas par bstan pa'o/ /dang po ni/ de nas byang chub nas/ dngos grub rnams ci la gnas zhes so/ /gnyis pa ni/ de bzhin gshegs pa nas/ rdo rje la gnas so/ /zhes so/ /gsum pa ni/ byang chub nas/ gang la yang mi gnas so/ /zhes so/ gsum pa byang sems rnams the tshom chod pa ni/ de nas byang chub nas/ cang mi smra bar 'khod do/ /zhes so/ lnga pa bsam bstan gyi dkyil 'khor la brten nas dbang bskur tshul la bzhi/

ston pa 'od gsal las bzhengs nas bsam gtan gyi dkyil 'khor nyan par bskul ba/ 'khor rnams kyis de bshad par gsol ba/ gsol ba btab pa'i don bshad pa/ don bsdu ba'o/ /dang po ni/ bcom ldan nas/ ting nge 'dzin dkyil 'khor nyon cig /ces so/ /gnyis pa ni/ de nas yang de bzhin gshegs pa nas/ bshad du gsol zhes so/ /gsum pa la bzhi/ bsam gtan gyi dkyil 'khor sgrub pa'i sngon du bdag bskyed sgom tshul/ de nas phyag rgya dang snyoms par zhugs te bsam gtan gyi dkyil 'khor sgrub cing mchod pa/ slob ma la dbang bskur ba lhag ma'i mtshon byed nang dbang bskur ba/ dbang bskur ba'i phan yon no/ /dang po ni/ nam mkha'i dbyings kyi dbus bsam pa/ nas/ 'khor lo can kun gzhug par bya/ /zhes so/ /gnyis pa ni/ mchod pa'i nas/ rtag tu bya zhes so/ /gsum pa ni/ slob dpon snying khar rab bsgoms nas/ nas/ thams cad cho ga bzhin du dbab/ /zhes so/ /bzhi pa ni/ sems can kun la phan 'dod pa'i/ nas 'grub par 'gyur zhes so/ /bzhi pa don bsdu ba ni/ sangs rgyas dang nas/ bsam gtan gyi dkyil 'khor ro/ /zhes so/ /drug pa las tshogs mchod pa dam tshig rnams spel nas bstan pa la drug /rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i rnal 'byor gyis gdug pa rnams tshar gcad pa/ mchod pa'i cho ga la lus brtan par byed pa'i cho ga /rdzogs rim pa'i lus ngag gi dam tshig /le'u bco lnga pa las gsungs pa'i las phra mo'i lhag ma/ las kyi mthar rdo rje añjan sgrub pa'i cho ga bstan pa'o/ /dang po ni/ de nas yang phyag na rdo rje nas/ rdo rje'i sbyor bas gdab par bya/ ces so/ /gnyis pa la lnga/ nang gi sbyin sreg gi mchod pa/ yid du 'ong ba'i yul lnga'i thun mong gi mchod pa/ rigs kyi sras bskrun te bsrung ba dang gso ba la sogs pa'i khyad par gyi mchod pa/ sems can thams cad kyi don du dmigs nas sa la longs spyod pa'i phul du byung ba'i mchod pa/

mchod pa rnams sgrub pa la mtshan 'dzin gyi dri ma dag par bya ba'i thabs bstan pa'o/ /dang po ni/ de nas yang phyag na rdo rjes nas/ cho ga bzhin du yongs su brtag /ces so/ /gnyis pa ni/ de nas yang nas/ dam tshig shin tu 'da' dka' ba'o/ /zhes so/ /gsum pa ni/ de nas yang nas/ sangs rgyas byang chub thob par 'gyur zhes so/ /bzhi pa ni/ de nas yang nas/ sdom pa 'di ni rmad po che/ /zhes so/ /lnga pa ni/ de nas yang nas/ 'dir ni yong ye 'jig par 'gyur/ /zhes so/ /gsum pa lus brtas pa'i cho ga ni/ de nas yang phyag na rdo rjes nas/ 'gyur bar 'di ni dogs pa med/ ces so/ /bzhi pa ni/ de nas yang nas/ rdo rje gsum mchog phyag mi bya'o/ /zhes so/ /lnga pa las phra mo'i lhag ma bstan pa la gnyis/ dug bsal ba la sogs pa'i cho ga dang*/ de ltar byed pa'i sdigs pas gzhan bsrung ba'i cho ga bstan pa'o/ /dang po ni/ de nas yang nas sa bon gsang gsum las byung ba'o/ /zhes so/ /gnyis pa ni/ de nas yang nas/ gsang ba gsum gyi gnas bsdus pa'o/ /zhes so/ /drug pa las kyi mthar rdo rje añja na sgrub pa'i cho ga bstan pa ni/ de nas yang nas/ kun tu bzang pos gsungs so zhes so/ /bdun pa rgyud kyi che ba la bzhi/ rgyud 'di la dad cing sgom pa la sangs rgyas thams cad kyi gsang ba gsum gyi gnad rtogs dgos par bstan pa/ rgyud shin du rnyed dka' bar bstan pa/ rgyud 'di la brten nas tshe 'dir mchog 'grub par bstan pa/ rgyud shin tu zab par bstan pa'o/ /dang po ni/ de nas bcom ldan 'das nas/ cang mi gsung bar gyur to zhes so/ /gnyis pa ni/ de nas phyag na rdo rje nas/ sems can rnams la skal ba med pa'i phyir ro zhes so/ /gsum pa ni/ 'on kyang nas/ grangs su 'gro'i zhes so/ /bzhi pa la gsum/ rjes 'jug gi gang zag bzhis rgyud ma lus pa nyan yang don ma rtogs par bstan pa'i phyir sngon byung la byang chub sems dpa' rnams bshums pa/

rjes 'jug la rin po che lta bu'i gang zag gis de rnams dbugs 'byin pa bstan pa'i phyir byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi mya ngan bsal ba'i dri lan/ rin po che lta bu'i gang zag gis de dag gi rab rib bsal bas de dag gis kyang de kho na nyid rtogs par bstan pa'o/ /dang po ni/ de nas byang chub nas/ rab tu dus so/ /zhes so/ /gnyis pa ni/ de nas de bzhin gshegs pa nas/ gsang ba'i yi ge rnam par dag pa'i phyir ro zhes so/ /gsum pa ni/ de nas byang chub nas/ gnas par gyur to zhes so/ /brgyad pa the tshom chod nas nyams su blangs pa'i 'bras bus bstan pa la lnga/ thob bya'i 'bras bu bstan pa'i phyir gtso bo 'od gsal du zhugs pa/ de la lha mo bzhi'i glus bzhengs par bskul ba/ 'od gsal las bzhengs nas rigs bzhi'i ngo bos spyan sogs dang snyoms par zhugs pa/ de'i 'og tu rje gsum gyis nam mkha'i khams thams cad gang bar bstan pa/ ston pa ye shes kyi phyag rgya dang snyoms par 'jug pas 'gro ba'i don mdzad tshul lo/ /dang po ni/ de nas bcom ldan 'das nas/ rdo rje btsun mo'i bha ga la zhugs so/ /zhes so/ /gnyis pa ni/ de nas de bzhin gshegs pa nas/ dgyes par mdzad du gsol zhes so/ /gsum pa ni/ de nas bcom ldan 'das nas/ mi gsung bar gyur to zhes so/ /bzhi pa ni/ de nas nam mkha'i dbyings nas/ gnas par gyur to zhes so/ /lnga pa la bzhi/ snyoms par zhugs pa'i ye shes kyi 'od zer gyis sems can rnams la dbang bskur bas de rnams kun du bzang bo'i ming can du gyur pa/ sems can kun du bzang bor mnyam pa nyid du bstan pa 'khor rnams kyis gzigs tshul/ de la 'khor rnams ngo mtshar nas zhu ba/ 'dod chags kyi rang bzhin 'od gsal nyid yin pa ngo mtshar rgyu med par bstan pa'o/ /dang po ni/ de nas rdo rje nam mkha'i dbyings 'di nas/ dbang bskur bar gyur to zhes so/ /gnyis pa ni/ de nas de bzhin gshegs pa nas/

bde bar gshegs pa mthong lags so/ zhes so/ /gsum pa ni/ de nas bcom ldan nas ngo mtshar to zhes so/ /bzhi pa ni/ de nas phyag na rdo rje nas/ cang mi gsung bar gyur to zhes so/ /dgu ba rgyud yongs su gtad pa la gsum/ 'dus pa sangs rgyas byang sems rnams la spyir gtad pa/ bye brag tu rdo rje chos la gtad de zhal gyis bzhes pa/ rgyud gtad pa'i 'og tu 'khor rnams rdo rje gsum du gyur par bstan pa'o/ /dang po ni/ de nas bcom ldan 'das nas/ 'di la skal ba yod pa'i phyir ro/ /zhes so/ /gnyis pa ni/ de nas phyag na rdo rje nas/ cang mi gsung bar gyur to zhes so/ /gsum pa ni/ de nas de bzhin gshegs pa nas/ dmigs nas cang mi gsung bar gyur to zhes so/ /bzhi pa mjug sdud ni/ de skad ces bka' stsal to zhes so/ /gnyis pa mtshan don no/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad zhes pa nas/ le'u ste bcu bdun pa'o/ /zhes pa'i bar ro/ /bzhi pa mjug gi don rgyud 'di gang gis bsgyur ba ni/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po/ zhes pa nas/ g.yar khral du 'tshal ba'o/ /zhes pa'i bar ro/ /de yan chad ni rtsa rgyud kyi gzhung tshan so so'i ngos 'dzin gyi bsdus don yin no/ /da ni le'u bco brgyad pa rgyud phyi ma'i gzhung so so'i don tshan ngos bzung gi bsdus don/ dpal nā ro ba'i 'grel ba dang bstun nas bshad par bya ste/ de la gsum/ rgyud kyi don la dri ba zhu ba'i sngon 'gro dang*/ zhus lan dngos dang*/ zhus zin pa'i skor ro/ /dang po la gnyis/ byams pa sogs kyis rtsa rgyud kyi don gsan pas thugs su chud nas dga' bas bstod cing bsngags pa dang*/ /de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis de la don dang mthun pa'i lan gnang ba'o/ /dang po ni/ de nas byams pa la sogs pa zhes pa nas/ e ma'o mchog tu mya ngan 'das/ /zhes pa'i bar ro/ /gnyis pa ni/ de nas de bzhin gshegs pa nas/ sems dpa' chen po de de bzhin no/ /zhes so/

/gnyis pa la gnyis/ zhu pa dang*/ de'i lan gsungs pa'o/ /dang po la gsum/ mchod de zhu ba'i snyan gsan dbab pa dang*/ de la legs pa'i lan gsungs pa dang*/ don tshan so sor phye nas zhus pa'o/ /dang po ni/ de nas byang chub sems dpa' chen po/ nas/ mgon po khyod la gsol ba 'tshal/ /zhes so/ /gnyis pa ni/ de nas de bzhin gshegs pa nas/ yon tan 'byung gnas legs so legs/ zhes so/ /gsum pa la gnyis/ dga' ste phyag btsal ba dang*/ so sor zhus pa dngos so/ /dang po ni/ de nas byang chub sems dpa' kun nas/ /'di yi som nyi zhus par gyur/ zhes so/ /gnyis pa ni/ gsang ba zhes 'dir gang la bgyi/ nas/ sna tshogs ji ltar byed par 'gyur/ /zhes pa'i bar te/ 'di la rtsa rgyud las gsungs pa'i gsang ba zhes pa'i don zhus pa dang*/ de bzhin du 'dus pa dang*/ rgyud kyi 'brel ba dang*/ rnal 'byor dang*/ rgyud dang*/ de nyid rigs lnga dang*/ gsang ba rnam pa gsum dang*/ gsang chen rigs gcig dang*/ dam pa rigs brgyad dbye ba dang*/ byang chub kyi sems dang*/ rig pa'i skyes bu dang*/ badz+ra dh+rika sogs snying po lnga dang*/ rig dang*/ mo ha sogs bzhi dang*/ ra ti dang*/ phun tshogs dang*/ ya man+ta kri ta sogs khro bo'i bzhi'i snying po dang*/ kun tu spyod pa dang*/ sngags kyi spyod pa dang*/ bzlas pa dang*/ rgyas gdab pa dang*/ chos 'byung dang*/ sdom pa dang*/ rigs gsum gyi don mdzad tshul dang*/ dkyil 'khor dang*/ phyag rgya dgod pa dang*/ me tog dang*/ mchod rten dang*/ ye shes kyi 'khor lo dang*/ gnas dang*/ bskul ba dang gtor ba dang*/ spyan drangs pa dang bcing ba dang dbang bskur ba dang*/ rig pa'i brtul zhugs dang*/ bdud rtsi lnga dang*/ dpa' bo lnga dang*/ dngos grub tha ma dang*/ dngos grub mchog dang*/ de'i thabs dang*/ thabs byung dang*/ bka' ji ltar bsgo ba dang*/ las tshogs ji ltar byed pa stong gsum gyi grangs zhus so/ /gnyis pa de'i lan so sor gsungs pa la lnga/

de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis 'khor gyis zhus pa'i tshig gsan nas don gyis 'chad par zhal bzhes gnang ste cang mi gsung bar bzhugs pa dang*/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams dga' nas yid kyis bskul ba dang*/ de bzhin gshegs pas 'khor la nyan par bskul ba dang*/ nyan par khas blangs te legs so phul nas cang mi smra bar 'khod pa dang*/ lan so sor gsungs pa dngos so/ /dang po ni/ de nas de bzhin gshegs pa nas/ cang mi gsung bar gyur to zhes so/ /gnyis pa ni/ de nas byang chub sems dpa' che/ nas/ mgon la yang dang yang du bskul/ /zhes so/ /gsum pa ni/ de nas de bzhin gshegs pa nas/ zhus pa rgya chen nyan par gyis/ zhes so/ /bzhi pa ni/ de nas byang chub sems dpa' nas/ cang mi smra bar gyur to zhes so/ /lnga pa ni/ de nas de bzhin gshegs pa de dag thams cad nas mi gsung bar bzhugs par gyur to/ /zhes pa'i bar te/ de yang de nas de bzhin gshegs pa nas/ gsung gcig gis bka' stsal ba zhes mtshams sbyar te/ dang po gsang ba'i don ni/ sku gsung thugs ni rnam pa gsum/ gsang ba zhes ni bstan pa yin/ zhes so/ /gnyis pa ni/ sangs rgyas thams cad ces bya ba/ tshogs pa 'dus pa yin par bshad/ ces so/ /gsum pa 'brel ba ni/ lnga ba dang ni dgu ba dang*/ nas/ bstan pas yongs su grol ba yin/ zhes so/ /de nas rnal 'byor dang rgyud gnyis so sor byas na/ bzhi pa ni/ thabs dang shes rab snyoms 'jug pa/ nas/ thabs ni dngos po'i mtshan nyid do/ /zhes so/ /lnga pa ni/ rgyud ni rgyud zhes bya bar grags/ nas/ gsum gyis rgyud kyi don bsdus pa'o/ /zhes so/ /de nas rigs ni lnga dang gsum dag dang*/ nas/ de ni phyir ma'i rgyud du 'dod ces lha'i rigs kyi rnam dbye mdor bstan nas/ drug pa rigs lnga ni/ de nyid rnam pa lnga ru bshad/ ces so/ /bdun pa ni/ gsang ba rnam pa gsum du bshad/ ces so/ /brgyad pa rigs gcig na/ lhag pa'i lha ni gsang chen te/

/zhes so/ /dgu pa ni/ dam pa'i rigs ni rnam pa brgya/ zhes so/ /bcu ba byang chub kyi sems ni/ thog ma tha ma med zhi ba/ nas/ byang chub sems zhes bya ba yin/ zhes so/ /bcu gcig pa rig pa'i skyes bu ni/ sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje yis/ /nas/ rig pa'i skyes bu zhes brjod do/ /zhes so/ /bcu gnyis pa rigs lnga las badz+ra dh+rika ni/ rgyud lnga dang ni 'bras bu lnga/ nas/ rnam shes rdo rje 'dzin du 'dod/ ces so/ /bcu gsum pa dzi na dzika ni/ yod dang med dang dbus las 'das/ nas/ skye las rgyal ba dzi na dzika /ces so/ /bcu bzhi pa rat+na dh+rika ni/ don rnams thams cad nas/ rat+na dh+rika tu brjod ces so/ /bco lnga pa ā ro lika ni/ mtshan gzhi mtshan nyid nas/ ā ro lika ces bshad pa yin/ zhes so/ /bcu drug pa pradz+nyā dh+rika ni/ rnam shes rab mthar nas/ shes rab 'dzin ces bya bar bshad/ /ces so/ /bcu bdun pa rigs kyi khyad par ni/ rigs ni rgyud ces bya bar bshad/ nas/ de ni yin par bshad ces spyir bstan pa/ rigs de la dbye na zhe sdang gi rigs la sogs pa lnga yod ces ston pa ni/ rgyu 'bras gnyis la sdang bas na/ nas/ 'du byed rtag tu phrag dog yin/ /zhes gsungs nas/ de'i don bsdu ba ni/ byang chub sems kyi ngo bo nyid/ nas/ sems ni 'dod chags zhes byar bshad/ ces so/ /bco brgyad pa mo ha ni/ dam tshig sna tshogs 'dra ba yis/ nas/ nga rgyal byed pa rmongs zhes bshad/ /ces so/ bcu dgu pa dwe ṣa ni/ de la phan tshun 'dzer ba ni/ zhe sdang zhes ni bya bar bshad/ ces so/ /nyi shu ba rā ga ni/ mtshan nyid 'dod chags zhen pa yin/ zhes so/ /nyer gcig pa badz+ra ni/ ye shes 'di ni rdo rjer bshad/ ces so/ /nyer gnyis pa ra ti ni/ dga' ba rdzogs pa'i longs spyod mchog /ces so/ /nyer gsum pa phun tshogs ni/ bud med bde mchog phun sum tshogs/ nas/ rdo rje theg pa zhes bshad do/ /zhes so/ /nyer bzhi pa ya man+ta krita ni/

mi 'jig bdag nyid chos rnams ni/ nas/ de nyid gshin rje mthar byed do/ /zhes so/ /nyer lnga pa pradz+nyā ta krita ni/ rnam shes min bdag nas/ shes mthar byed ces so/ /nyer drug pa pad+ma n+ta krita ni/ brjod med bdag nyid nas/ pad mthar phyed ces so/ /nyer bdun pa pradz+nyā ta krita ni/ mi rtog bdag nyid nas/ bgegs mthar byed ces so/ /khro bo bzhi'i sngags don so sor bstan pa de'i don bsdu ba ni/ mi 'jig rnam par nas/ bde ba thob par 'gyur zhes so/ /yang drang nges dang sbyar te 'chad pa ni/ gti mug gti mug longs spyod pas/ nas/ las skyes 'bras bu rnam par dag /ces so/ /de'i zhar la khro bo drug ston pa ni/ gzung dang chags pa nyid dang ni/ nas/ khro bo'i dbang bor rnam par grags/ zhes so/ /yang zhar la sems dpa' drug ston pa ni/ dam tshig rdo rje la sogs drug /ces so/ /yang yum bzhi dang 'jam dpal ni/ sa la sogs pa rnam pa lnga/ zhes so/ /'byung dang 'byung las gyur par grags ni/ 'byung ba ni yum bzhi dang*/ 'byung ba las gyur pa ni/ sa'i snying po sogs sems dpa' drug ste/ rig pa'i rgyal po zhes bshad do/ /zhes pa'i rig pa ni yum dang rgyal po ni sems dpa' rnams so/ /yang gzugs rdo rje la sogs drug ni rdo rje ma lnga dang kun du bzang po ste drug go /rdo rje bdag po zhes bshad do ni rdo rje 'chang dkyil 'khor gyi bdag por bstan to/ /lha de rnams rdo rje 'chang gi sku gsung thugs las byung ba ni/ sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje las/ bdag nyid chen po kun du byung*/ zhes so/ /phyi ma 'di rnams bri ba'i skabs su mi bsal yang lan gyis kha bskang te lha so gnyis tshang bar gsungs so/ /nyer brgyad pa ni thabs dang shes rab las byung ba'i/ nas/ kun du spyod pa zhes bshad do/ /zhes so/ /nyer dgu pa sngags kyi spyod pa ni/ dbang po dang ni yul rnams kyi/ nas/ sngags kyi spyod pa zhes bshad do/

/zhes so/ /sum cu pa bzlas pa ni/ rang rang gi ni ngo bo nyid/ nas/ de nyid bskul ba smra ba'o/ /zhes so/ /so gcig pa rgyas gdab pa ni/ ji ltar thugs sogs byin rlob pa/ nas/ bskal ba bye bar 'byung mi 'gyur/ /zhes pa'i bar te/ 'dir sku gsung thugs byin gyis rlob pa dang*/ ye shes sems dpa' bsgom pa ste longs spyod bzhi dang lha so so'i rigs bdag gis dbang bskur ba dang*/ 'bru gsum dang bcas pa rnams ston pa 'byung ngo*/ /so gnyis pa chos 'byung srung 'khor ni/ longs spyod bzhi dang yang dag ldan/ nas/ mi g.yo ba dang mtshungs par 'khor/ zhes so/ /de ye shes kyi bdag nyid du ston pa ni/ de ltar chos 'byung nas/ rab tu 'byung zhes so/ /so gsum pa rgyud sdom ni/ rdo rje can gyis der ston pa nas/ rim pa'i dbye bas phye ba yin/ /zhes pa'i bar te/ /'dis rim pa gnyis dang*/ dkyil 'khor sgrub pa dang*/ snying po bskul ba dang*/ rnal 'byor gyi spyod pa dang*/ rmad du byung ba'i spyod pa dang*/ dam tshig dang sdom pa rnams kyi rim pa rtsa rgyud las gsungs pa bsdus nas ston no/ /so bzhi pa ni/ gzugs sgra la sogs 'dod pa ni/ nas/ grub pa'i bgrod pa gzhan yin no/ /zhes pa'i bar ro/ /so lnga ba dkyil 'khor ni/ bha ga'i dkyil 'khor zhes grags dang*/ nas/ gsum po dkyil 'khor yin par gsungs/ zhes so/ /so drug pa ni/ phyag rgya dgod pa ni/ phung po skye mched khams rnams ni/ nas/ rigs kyi kha dog dag gis brtag /ces so/ /so drug pa me tog gi don ni/ lha mo dgu dang nam mkha'i khams/ nas/ rigs kyis rim gyi dgod par bya/ zhes so/ /so bdun pa ni/ mchod rten sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /bzhugs gnas pho brang yin par bshad/ /ces so/ /so brgyad pa ye shes kyi 'khor lo ni/ /ye shes sems dpas gang reg pa dang*/ ye shes 'khor lo zhes bshad do/ /zhes so/ /so dgu pa gnas ni/ mi 'gyur rdo rje gsum yi ge

/sa bon yi ge gnas zhes bshad/ /ces so/ /bzhi bcu ba bskul ba ni/ sku gsung thugs kyi de nyid ni/ sad par bya ba bskul ba yin/ /zhes so/ /zhe gcig pa gtong ba ni/ phyogs bcu'i nas gtong ba yin zhes so/ /zhe gnyis pa spyan drang ba ni/ rdo rje can kun nas/ spyan drang ba'o zhes so/ /zhe gsum pa bcing ba ni/ rdo rje can gyi gnas de yi/ nas/ bcing ba yin par bshad ces so/ /zhe bzhi pa dbang bskur ba la dbang bzhi bskur ba mdor bstan pa dang*/ gsang dbang bskur tshul rgyas par bshad pa gnyis kyi dang po ni/ sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje yi/ nas/ de yang bzhi pa de bzhin no/ /zhes dang*/ gnyis pa ni/ mig yangs sngags kyi snod du rung*/ nas/ shes rab ye shes bdag nyid 'gyur/ /zhes so/ /zhe lnga pa rig pa'i brtul zhugs ni/ rig pa'i lha mo de nyid ni/ /nas/ de yi dngos grub mchog mi 'gyur/ /zhes so/ /zhe drug pa bdud rtsi lnga ni/ tha mal lus kyi chos la ni/ /nas/ bza' ba'i sbyor bas bza' bar bya/ /zhes so/ /zhe bdun pa dpa' bo lnga ni/ bsgrub bya'i dngos grub cho ga yis/ /nas gzhan du de ni 'grub mi 'gyur/ /zhes so/ /zhe brgyad pa dngos grub tha ma ni/ /mi snang la sogs dngos grub ni/ /tha mal ba zhes bshad pa yin zhes so/ /zhe dgu pa dngos grub mchog ni/ sangs rgyas nyid bsgrub sangs rgyas kyis/ /dngos grub mchog ces gsungs pa yin/ zhes so/ /lnga bcu pa gnas la mdor bstan rgyas bshad gnyis kyi dang po ni/ thabs ni rnam pa bzhi pa dag /nas/ bsgrub pa chen po bzhi pa'o zhes so/ /rgyas bshad la bskyed rdzogs gnyis te/ /thun mong mchog gi bye brag gis/ /bsnyen pa rnam pa gnyis su 'gyur/ /rdo rje bzhi bo thun mong ste/ ye shes bdud rtsi mchog yin no/ /gsungs nas/ bskyed rim pa'i bsnyen sgrub yan lag bzhi ba dgos pa dang bcas pa ni/ dang po stong nyid byang chub ste/ nas/ tha mal bsgrub la bsnyen par bya/

/zhes so/ /rdzogs rim pa'i de bzhi las bsnyen pa sbyor ba yan lag drug dgos/ mchog ni ye shes bdud rtsi nyid/ /sbyor ba drug gis bya ba yin/ /zhes gsungs nas/ bsnyen pa yan lag drug gis ni/ /nas/ 'byung mi 'gyur zhes pas de med na mchog mi 'grub par bstan cing*/ drug po so sor 'chad pa la dbye ba dang*/ rgyas bshad gnyis kyi dang po ni/ so sor sdud dang bsam gtan dang*/ nas/ sbyor ba yan lag drug tu bshad/ /ces gsungs ste/ so sor rgyas par bshad pa ni/ dbang po bcu po rnams kyi yang*/ nas/ ting nge 'dzin ces bya bar bshad/ /ces so/ /de'i phan yon ni/ so sor sdud la snyoms 'jug na/ nas/ sgrib pa rnams dang bral bar 'gyur/ /zhes so/ /nyer bsgrub ni/ snying po de ni thugs ka ru/ /nas/ bsgom pa nye bar sgrub pa'o/ /zhes so/ /sgrub pa ni/ ji srid mthong ba de srid du/ nas/ thams cad du ni rtag tu bya/ zhes so/ /spyod pa'i ting nge 'dzin spyi bstan nas/ dpog chog ni/ gal te zla drug gis ni/ nas/ 'grub pa nges pas nye bar 'gyur/ zhes so/ /yang phur gdab ni/ rigs kyi dbye ba'i sbyor bas ni/ /rdo rje phur bus phur bu gdab/ / ces so/ /dbang du bya ba dang*/ bsrung ba dang*/ 'dod pa la longs spyod pa'i ting nge 'dzin ni/ de nas dbang du bya ba dang*/ nas/ bsgrub par bya ba'i lus la 'god/ ces so/ /mi bskyod pas bsdus pa'i ting nge 'dzin gtso bor ston pa ni/ yongs su gyur las phyag rgya bzhi/ nas/ de 'og byang chub bsgrub par bya/ zhes so/ /lha mo bzhis rdo rje 'chang 'od gsal las bzhengs par bskul ba ni/ bskul ba'i glu dbyangs bzhi yis ni/ nas/ lus bsgom mo zhes so/ /bzhengs nas 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa ni/ bzhi yi kha tog rnam par dbye/ nas/ chos kyi phyag rgyas so zhes so/ /sems can thams cad la dbang bskur bas kun tu bzang bor gyu?r pa ni/ 'khor lo sgyur ba'i rgyal po drug

/nas/ gnyis su med par byed sgrub pa zhes so/ /de nas sgrub pa chen po ni/ sngar bshad pa yi rim gyis ni/ nas sgrub pa chen po zhes so bshad do zhes so/ /yang bskyed rim pa'i las kyi bsnyen sgrub bzhi las bsnyen pa ni/ bsnyen pa'i dus su gtsug tor che/ /sbyor ba yid kyi gzugs su dmigs/ zhes so/ /nyer sgrub ni/ nye bar sgrub pa'i dus su ni/ bdud rtsi 'khyil ba'i gzugs kyi bar/ zhes so/ /sgrub pa ni/ sngags pas cho ga shes pa yis/ sgrub pa rang lha'i sbyor bas bya/ zhes so/ /sgrub chen ni/ sgrub pa chen po'i dus su ni/ nas/ nges par 'byung bar mi 'gyur ro/ /zhes so/ /snyoms 'jug gi dus kyi sgrub pa bzhi ni/ bsgrub bya sgrub par yang dag sbyor/ nas/ sgrub pa chen po zhes bshad do zhes so/ /de rnams kyis thabs so sor bstan pa/ nga gcig pa thabs las byung ba ni/ dpal ldan sangs rgyas kun gyi bdag /nas/ de nyid chos rnams chos nyid do zhes so/ /nga gnyis pa bka' bsgo ba ni/ las dang rjes mthun gang gang gis/ nas/ rang gi 'khor lo bka' yang bsgo/ /zhes so/ /nga gsum pa las tshogs ji ltar byed pa ni/ bsgrub bya'i lus ngag yin pa la'ang*/ zhes pa nas/ khro la gtum pas rab tu bsgrub/ /zhes pa'o/ /zhes pa'i bar te/ 'dis kha sbyar dbye ba byed tshul dang bcas drag las zhig gsal bar bstan nas/ las gzhan rnams mdor bsdus te gsungs so/ /gsum pa zhus zin mjug gi skor la/ de nas bcom ldan 'das nas/ mi gsung bar bzhugs par gyur to/ /zhes pas zhus pa'i lan de bzhin gshegs pas gsungs zin nas cang mi gsung bar bzhugs par bstan/ de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po nas/ gal te gos gyur 'bras bu gang zhes pas de bzhin gshegs pa la byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis bstod/ de nas de bzhin gshegs pa nas/ byas nas las rnams brtsam par bya/ zhes pas de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis legs so dang bcas te lan gnang*/

de nas byang chub sems dpa' nas/ sangs rgyas nyid kyi 'bras bu stsol zhes pas byang sems rnams kyi de bzhin gshegs pa la chos bstan pa'i legs so dang bcas pa phul/ de nas de bzhin gshegs pa nas/ yongs su spang bar mi bya'o/ /zhes pas de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis byang sems rnams dbugs dbyung ste rgyud bzung bar gdams/ de nas byang chub sems dpa' nas/ byang chub sems 'dra rgya chen de la phyag 'tshal lo zhes dkyil 'khor ba'i lha rnams bstod phyag /gang zhig thogs ma med dngos sogs rkang ba bzhis rgyud gsungs pa'i sgo nas bstod phyag /gang zhig dngos grub mchog gi thabs ni 'di sgom zhing*/ zhes sogs tshigs bcad lngas rgyud 'dzin pa'i sgrub pa po rnams la bstod phyag mdzad la/ bstod pa'i tshig ni zhi ba 'dis/ zhes pa nas/ rgyud 'di legs par gsungs pa yin/ /zhes pa'i bar gyis bstod pa'i phan yon dang*/ rjes su yid rang ba dang*/ rgyud rdzogs par gsungs pa la dga' zhing bsngags so/ /de bzhin gshegs pa de dag /zhes pa nas/ cang mi gsung bar gyur to zhes pa'i bar gyis/ /de bzhin gshegs pa rnams dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis rgyud kyi 'chad nyan re zhig rdzogs nas thugs bsam gtan la bzhugs par bstan/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad zhes pa nas/ le'u bco brgyad pa rdzogs so'i bar ni le'u mtshan no/ /rgya gar gyi mkhan po/ zhes pa nas/ zhus te gtan la phab pa'o zhes pa'i bar ni 'gyur byung ngo*/ /smras pa/ rgyud sde stong phrag sum cu gsum rtsa dang*/ chos kyi phung po brgyad khri bzhi stong gi /rtse mo 'dus pa'i rgyud kyi don tshan rnams/ /so so'i ngos 'dzin gsal bar phya 'dir ltos/ ces 'dus pa'i rtsa rgyud dang de'i rgyud phyi ma'i don tshan rnams kyang*/ rje nā ro ba'i 'grel pa dang bstun nas gzhung gi don tshan so so'i ngos 'dzin rgyud kyi sgo 'phar 'byed pa'i sde mig ces bya ba 'di'ang*/

shākya'i dge slong grags pa bshad sgrub kyis bstan pa'i mnga' bdag ko'u shri nang so yes kyis gsang du btsugs pa'i rgyud pa'i 'chad nyan spyi dang*/ khyad par du 'dus pa'i rgyud kyi 'chad nyan gyi rgyud la phan par bsams nas sbyar ba las/ phyis ko'u shri yes nyid kyis par bsgrubs pa'o/ /maṅga laṃ// //

mes po'i shul bzhag las/ co me grags pa bshad sgrub kyi gsung 'bum/ 'dus pa'i rtsa rgyud phyi ma dang bcas pa'i gzhung don so so'i ngos 'dzin rgyud kyi sgo 'byed lde mig bzhugs/ - PAGE 322-- PAGE 323- -PAGE 319-
